message: Feedback wanted Please provide any feedback you might have via email, Discord, or the GitHub page. Version 1.0.6-beta.7 will be promoted to the full 1.0.6 release, provided no more bugs are submitted within the next few days.
Beta 7 is out This update resolves compatability issues with the VRChat SDK Base package, version 3.10.2 Beta 1 and up.

I've been made aware of an import issue that occurs due to shipping the `SematicVersioning.dll` file with Easy Login.
A fix for this has been shipped.
